caption: The validation rule Block orders over an amount is ACTIVE, and the banner says the Free plan includes 1 active rule; the store name is hidden.
The payment rule Hide Bogus gateway over USD 100 shows ACTIVE, yet in our test checkout it did not hide the test payment method; the store name is hidden.
A second rule on the Free plan: the ACTIVE option is Locked because the 1 included rule is in use, so only Test or Inactive remain; the test email addresses and the store name are hidden.
The blocking rule at work: a $600.00 test checkout gets the red banner This order can't be completed with the current checkout details; the name and address are made up and the store name is hidden.
The same rule at $24.95: no message and the checkout carries on as normal; the store name in the header is hidden.
Monthly plans: Free with 1 active rule, then Starter, Starter Plus and Unlimited at $1 a month for the first 3 months after a 5-day free trial; the store name is hidden.

Shopify approval for Kedra Starter: a 5-day trial ending 21 Nov, then $1,00 due 21 Nov with $5,99 off for 3 charges. Approve stays greyed out until a payment method is added; nothing was approved and the store name is hidden.
